name: Hemant Taneja
evidence: Last credential: MIT S.B. and M.Eng. (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), 1999. MIT's own institutional repository (DSpace@MIT) catalogues his thesis 'A tactical planning model for a semiconductor waver [sic] fabrication facility', author 'Taneja, Hemant, 1975-', with dc.date.issued '1999' and the degree note quoted exactly: 'Thesis (S.B. and M.Eng.)--Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Dept. of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, 1999.' Handle: http://hdl.handle.net/1721.1/80131 . A search of DSpace@MIT for all authors named Taneja returns no other thesis by Hemant Taneja, so 1999 is the latest MIT degree year on record. Corroboration that MIT was his terminal institution and that the M.Eng was among his final degrees: his own General Catalyst bio, https://www.generalcatalyst.com/team/hemant-taneja , states 'I ... hold five degrees from MIT: M.Eng. EECS, S.M. Operations Research, S.B. Biology, S.B. Mathematics, and S.B. EECS.' English Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hemant_Taneja) likewise says 'He earned three undergraduate and two graduate degrees from MIT.' No source places any MIT degree after 1999.

name: Aileen Lee
evidence: Last credential: MBA, Harvard Business School, 1997. English Wikipedia's Aileen Lee article states, quoted exactly: 'Lee earned her bachelor's degree from the MIT Sloan School of Management in 1992. After MIT, she worked as a financial analyst for two years at Morgan Stanley... She earned her MBA from Harvard Business School in 1997.' The MBA sentence is cited in the article to a published profile (ref name 'insiders'), and the article's infobox lists alma mater as 'Massachusetts Institute of Technology / Harvard Business School' with the Harvard Business School alumni category applied. The 1992 MIT Sloan bachelor's plus two years at Morgan Stanley is consistent with a 1995-1997 HBS MBA. No later credential of any kind is recorded; her career from 1997 is Gap Inc. then Kleiner Perkins then Cowboy Ventures. URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aileen_Lee

name: Kendrick Lamar
evidence: Last credential COMPLETED: high school diploma, Centennial High School, Compton, California, 2005. He never completed any tertiary credential, so the high-school diploma is the a2 anchor under the dropout rule. English Wikipedia's Kendrick Lamar article states, quoted exactly: 'Lamar later attended Centennial High School... He graduated from high school in 2005 as a straight-A student.' (cited there to Joel 'Shake' Zela, HipHopDX, 31 December 2010). The same paragraph states, quoted exactly: 'He considered studying psychology and astronomy in college, but suspended his academic pursuits to focus on his music career' - i.e. no college credential was completed. He signed with Top Dawg Entertainment in 2005. URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kendrick_Lamar

name: Luciana Lixandru
evidence: Last credential: bachelor's degree (mathematics and economics), Georgetown University, Washington DC, 2007. Trending Topics (trendingtopics.eu), 'Romanian-born Investor Luciana Lixandru Leaves Accel Partners To Run Sequoia Capital In Europe', states, quoted exactly: 'Lixandru graduated from Georgetown University in Washington, US, in 2007, and joined Morgan Stanley as an analyst the same year. Two years later, she started working with Summit Partner as an Associate, to finally join Accel Partners in 2011.' Corroboration of the institution and subject from Sifted's profile 'Brunch with Luciana Lixandru, Sequoia's new European chief' (https://sifted.eu/articles/brunch-with-luciana-sequoia), quoted exactly: 'It was her own teacher who suggested Lixandru study in the US, eventually prompting her to study maths and economics at Georgetown University in Washington on a scholarship.' Confidence is medium, not high, because some contact-scraper aggregator pages (rocketreach, lessie.ai) additionally list a Stanford GSB MBA with no year; the Sifted profile describes her going straight from Georgetown into finance and never returning to graduate school, and no dated source supports a Stanford degree. If a Stanford MBA is later confirmed with a year, this anchor would move.
